lines.en: I don't want to call her right now...
lines.zh: 我现在不想叫她……

lines.en: I don't think I should call Uta right now...
lines.zh: 我觉得现在不该打给 Uta……

lines.en: if uta_love >= 35 and utaspecial35 == True and utadate35 == False:
I tap on Uta's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Uta 的名字，等她接电话。

lines.en: There's no answer. She might be at her club right now.
lines.zh: 没人接。她现在也许在社团。

lines.en: I tap on Uta's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Uta 的名字，等她接电话。
: 唔啊啊啊啊啊……

lines.en: : Sensei?...Why are you callin' me so early?...
lines.zh: : Sensei……？你怎么这么早就打来了……
: 怎么了……？

lines.en: : Hey, Uta. I just wanted to see what you were up to.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Uta。我只是想看看你在干什么。
: 我在睡觉啊……

lines.en: : Sorry, but you're just so irresistable that I can't keep my mind off of you for even a second.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，可你实在太让人无法抗拒了，我一秒钟都没法不想你。

lines.en: : Guhhhhhh damn it...Why do I have to be so cute?
lines.zh: : 唔啊啊啊该死……我为什么非得这么可爱……

lines.en: : Come with me to the cafe and I'll buy you coffee or something.
lines.zh: : 陪我去咖啡馆吧，我给你买杯咖啡什么的。

lines.en: Uta yawns and then proceeds to knock something off of a table, pausing for a moment as she figures out if she wants to-
lines.zh: Uta 打了个哈欠，接着把桌上的什么东西撞了下去，停了一下，像是在考虑要不要——
: 呃……好吧。

lines.en: : But don't be expecting any interesting conversation.
lines.zh: : 但别指望有什么有意思的对话。
: 好。待会儿见。

lines.en: Uta and I meet up at the cafe and it quickly becomes apparent to me just how hard it is for her to do virtually anything in the morning.
lines.zh: 我和 Uta 在咖啡馆碰面，很快就发现她早上几乎什么事都做不成。

lines.en: I offer to buy her a drink and she accepts but, once we sit down at the table, she barely even touches it and just falls asleep instead.
lines.zh: 我说请她喝一杯，她答应了，可等我们在桌边坐下，她几乎没碰那杯饮料，直接睡着了。

lines.en: I am forced to spend the morning talking to a girl who may or may not be able to hear me and look like an idiot in the process.
lines.zh: 于是我只好一整个上午都在跟一个可能听得见、也可能听不见我说话的女孩讲话，看起来像个傻子。

lines.en: But at least I am an idiot in the company of a cute girl.
lines.zh: 但至少我是个有可爱女孩陪着的傻子。

lines.en: Several of them, actually, as Rin comes over to the table and glances confusedly between the two of us on several occasions throughout the morning.
lines.zh: 而且不止一个——整个上午 Rin 好几次走到桌边，困惑地在我俩之间来回看。

lines.en: Regardless, I somehow manage to get closer to Uta. Probably.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我总算和 Uta 近了一点。大概吧。

lines.en: At the very least, I know that she is comfortable sleeping around me.
lines.zh: 至少我知道，她在我身边睡得很安心。
$ uta_love += 1
{i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}
